lines.en: Sparks jump along my hair tips.
Thin lightning coils around me.
My hair stands straighter and harder now.
The grass edges singe where I step.

lines.zh: 脚下电光一闪，人已在前
lines.en: A crackle, and I'm a step ahead.
My gaze sits heavier than before.
My aura crackles with tiny pops.
Static pulls at my clothes.
Step by step, I close in.

lines.zh: 翅膀般的电弧拉在身后
lines.en: Arcs of lightning trail behind me.
A blue-white line cuts the air.
I walk on ki, never touching ground.
Current loops around my fingers.
Crackling hisses inside my aura.
Eyes closed, and the sparks still leap.
I clench my fist, then release.
My brow stays faintly furrowed.
Stones lift off the ground near me.
My shoulders drop and the air weighs down.
I flick a stray arc away.
My breathing is slow and even.
Not one golden strand is out of place.
I look up to the far edge of the sky.
As if holding something back.
The air smells of ozone.
I stand still, and the lightning won't.

lines.zh: 你后退了半步，我看到了
lines.en: You stepped back. I noticed.
This level is beyond your reach.
I look up, sparks in my eyes.
Don't fear. I don't strike at random.
Your ki is trembling faintly.
I ease my ki down a little.
You're tenser than a moment ago.
I tilt my head, appraising you.
Stand still like that. Don't move.
I raise a hand and you flinch.
Fine. I'll hold back.
You've got steady eyes, at least.
I give a thin smile.
The wind I make blows toward you.
I don't sense malice in you.
Then we won't fight. For now.
Sparks slide off my shoulder.
This look weighs more than the last.
It hurts, but I'm still standing.
My arcs jump out of rhythm.

lines.zh: 我吐了口气，重新压住气
lines.en: I exhale and steady my ki again.
Now I have to get serious.
Blood at my lip. Nothing serious.
I fall back without breaking rhythm.
A patch of my gi is scorched.
You've got some skill.
I smile, but my eyes don't.
I won't give you the next one.
Smells like food? After the fight.
We can talk strength after I eat.
I can't fight well hungry.
Food matters more than opponents.
I'm not fussy. Just make it hot.
My hand is already out.
It smells like something from home.
I'll finish that in one bite.
I'll get serious after eating.
My stomach is growling. Don't laugh.
An arc snaps at you.
I didn't move, but you recoiled.
Getting zapped isn't my fault.
Keep three feet of distance.
I raise a hand and block.
Your hand's numb now, isn't it?
Don't touch this shoulder.
Consider yourself lucky.
I ease half a step aside.
My aura blows your hair out of place.
Only an equal is worth standing beside.
I lower my ki so you can see me.
Training together is what's worth it.
If you can beat me, I'll be glad.
I offer my hand, without the sparks.
We walk together through any storm.
I'll guard this journey.
Agreed. We fight again next time.
Family matters more than power.
Two auras, joined as one.
One grab and it's mine.
I weigh it. Not heavy.
An arc slips off my fingertip.
Tuck it away before it gets zapped.
This thing has some use.
Holding it gently so it won't break.
I tuck it into my gi.
One glance and I've memorized it.
I toss it up and catch it.
Keep it. Settle later.
Your ki changed. I don't like it.
Then I'll get serious.
Lightning floods my whole body.
The ground splits under my feet.
I'll give you one chance.
My eyes narrow.
This is a different level than before.
I'm not smiling now.
The wind stops. The lightning doesn't.
Stand firm; I won't hold back.
I move first. Catch it.
My aura flings stones upward.
I won't give you the first move now.
I curl a finger and lightning gathers.
I see your opening.
One strike settles it.
I shadow your flank.
You raise a hand, I'm gone.
Arcs clear the way ahead of me.
I've read your read.
Ki gathers in my fist — watch.
Your left foot will leave the ground first.

lines.zh: 身子变小了，气一点没少。
lines.en: Smaller body, no less ki.
Ki pools around your feet.
You've backed against the stone.
No hurry. Make your move.
Does the air feel tight above you?
The thunder runs half a step ahead of me.
There's a pause in your technique.
That pause is the gap.
I come around behind you.
The circle closes.

lines.zh: 你眼里的余光不够用了
lines.en: Your peripheral vision isn't enough.
One last time. Do you yield?
A charged fist lands on your chest.
My elbow arrives before the sound.
An arc slashes your pauldron.

lines.zh: 我从上方落下，双拳齐出
lines.en: I drop from above, both fists out.
You blocked it, but your wrist shakes.
That punch was only seven tenths.

lines.zh: 电流顺着你的手臂上来
lines.en: Current climbs your arm.
My knee drives into your gut.
I strike once, then withdraw.
A patch of your armor is scorched.
The shockwave flattens a patch of grass.
That one whistled past your ear.

lines.zh: 我连打三下，第三下最重
lines.en: Three hits, the third heaviest.
Lightning bursts on my knuckles.
You slide two steps and hold.
Good. Again.
The lightning lands first. Then me.
My prints mark the scorched earth.
Arcs set the nearby grass alight.
The light in my hair settles.
I land without bending a knee.
The air still hums.
I wasn't born into this world.
Someone brought me here.

lines.zh: 四面八方的气我都感觉得到
lines.en: I feel ki from every direction.
This area is too quiet.
I draw the lightning back in.
Static still clings to my body.
Above me, the clouds part in a ring.
First, figure out where this is.
A ring of scorch marks my landing.
My aura stacks in layers.
One shrug and thunder rolls away.
Then I'll go one level higher.

lines.zh: 火焰和我身上的电打架
lines.en: Fire fights the lightning on my skin.
I land too hard and crack the ground.
Underwater every arc dies out.
The blast flattens my lightning flat.

lines.zh: 东西扎在肩头，被我弹开
lines.en: It hits my shoulder and I shrug it off.
This attack burrows into my ki.
Hunger weakens even my lightning.
Outside lightning clashes with mine.
In the void there's no ki to draw on.
